latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — animate images into video clips using ComfyUI workflows on the cloud.

- Upload PNG, JPG, WEBP, or BMP files up to 200MB; AI generates 5-second video clips in about 1–3 minutes.
- No need for manual ComfyUI setup — just describe the animation you want.
- Handles user authentication and session management automatically with 100 free credits for new users.
- Easy export to MP4 and other formats; supports status queries and batch operations.
- Automatic error handling and concise feedback for uploads, credits, and export actions.
